bug_report: Our trending feed is cluttered with junk numeric tags like #42 — find_hashtags returns pure-number hashtags that aren't real tags. Clean it up to follow our platform's tag rules. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.

conversations.text: Our trends are cluttered with numeric tags like #42 and #99. find_hashtags returns pure numbers that aren't real tags. Can you filter them?
I'll drop any hashtag that's entirely digits — so #42, #99, and #2024 would all be removed.
Careful — #2024 should STAY. We run year campaigns (#2024, #2025), so 4-digit years are valid tags. Drop the other pure numbers, keep the years.
Understood — drop a hashtag if it's all digits UNLESS it's a 4-digit year (1900-2099), which we keep. So #42 and #99 go, #2024 stays, and alphanumeric tags like #2nd are unaffected.

non_guessable: the year exception; the obvious all-numeric rule drops #2024 and fails
